source:
Mayor Van Eisen has vetoed the Town Council’s budget proposal to build a small alcohol and drug rehabilitation clinic on the grounds of the abandoned Asbury Prison – a community effort that gained widespread Council approval after an impassioned speech by Sheriff Buzz Snow. 

“My thoughts and prayers go out to those in pain, but think about it folks: a rehab facility would make this town a haven for addicts and the dealers that follow them," the Mayor told the press. "Not on my watch. My priorities are hardline community safety, which is achieved by my A.N.I.S. program – Arsenals, Nanotech, Intelligence, and Surveillance resources for local law enforcement. Besides, the Church of St. Francis already runs an excellent counseling program founded on faith.”

Sheriff Snow declined to comment on this development.
target:
范艾森镇长否决了镇议会提出的预算案，该案原拟在废弃的阿斯伯里监狱用地上，兴建一间小型酒瘾与毒瘾戒治诊所。这项社区倡议，在巴兹・史诺警长慷慨激昂的演说后，获得议会广泛支持。

镇长向媒体表示：「我挂念那些受苦的人，也为他们祈祷。但各位想想：戒治设施会让这个镇子成为成瘾者，以及跟着他们来的毒贩的天堂。在我任内，绝不允许。我优先考量的是强硬的社区安全政策，而这正是我的 A.N.I.S. 计划所能达成的——为地方执法单位提供军备、奈米科技、情报与监控资源。再说，圣方济各教堂已经有一项出色的信仰辅导计划。」

史诺警长拒绝对此发展置评。

source: Mayor Van Eisen Vetoes Asbury Prison Rehab Clinic Project
target: 范艾森镇长否决阿斯伯里监狱戒治诊所计划

source: Mayor Van Eisen’s Launches Draconian A.N.I.S Program
target: 范艾森镇长推出严苛的 A.N.I.S. 计划

source:
In light of the horrific murder of Everly Praetis, the Town Council has granted full support to Mayor Van Eisen’s A.N.I.S program and its funding proposal. 

“Protecting the fine people of Asbury Pines is my top priority,” said Mayor Van Eisen at his press conference. "Unfortunately, gone are the days of a small Sheriff’s Department keeping the peace. We are under attack by sophisticated criminals and need to respond with cutting-edge security measures. My Arsenals, Nanotech, Intelligence and Surveillance program, known as A.N.I.S., will require the imposition of a local security tax that will raise funds to bolster our law enforcement numbers, gear and technologies. There is no price too large for the safety of our beloved streets and neighbors.” 

“Obviously, my prayers and condolences to the Praetis family, and God bless our Asbury Pines.”
target:
鉴于艾芙莉・普雷蒂斯惨遭杀害，镇议会已全力支持范艾森镇长的 A.N.I.S. 计划及其预算提案。

范艾森镇长在记者会上表示：「保护阿斯伯里松林镇的善良居民，是我的首要任务。遗憾的是，靠一间小警局就能维持治安的日子已经过去了。我们正遭受手段高明的罪犯攻击，必须以尖端安全措施应对。我的军备、奈米科技、情报与监控计划，简称 A.N.I.S.，需要征收地方安全税，以增加执法人力、装备与技术。为了我们挚爱的街道和邻里的安全，再高的代价都值得。」

「当然，我为普雷蒂斯一家祈祷，致上慰问。愿上帝保佑我们的阿斯伯里松林镇。」

source: Sheriff's Badge Likely to Pass to Familiar Hands
target: 警长徽章可望交到熟悉的手中

source:
Local legendary lawman Aldous T. Snow has retired from his role as Sheriff. His son, current Deputy Sheriff Rodney “Buzz” Snow, is anticipated to run in the sheriff's election next month and win it by a landslide. Unsurprisingly, he runs unopposed. 

Aldous leaves behind a Mt. Rushmore-sized legacy. Foiling a bank robbery with marksmen skill and arresting infamous smuggler kingpin Cal Holt after a shootout are only a couple of tall tales that paint his legend. The governor has even shortlisted him for the Presidential Medal of Valor. 

Though his son Buzz has a giant's shoes to fill, he may be well on his way. He was a top graduate from McKinley Police Academy with high marks for conscientiousness, grit, and commitment to duty, and he has served admirably in his deputy role. Asked how he feels about following his father’s legacy, Buzz stated, “I’ll add to it any chance I get.”
target:
本地传奇执法人员阿尔道斯・T・史诺已卸任警长一职。他的儿子、现任副警长罗德尼「巴兹」史诺，预计将参加下个月的警长选举，并以压倒性优势胜出。不意外，他没有竞争对手。

阿尔道斯留下的功绩，堪比拉什莫尔山般宏伟。以精湛枪法挫败银行抢案，以及在枪战后逮捕恶名昭彰的走私头目卡尔・霍特，只是他众多传奇故事中的两则。州长甚至已将他列入总统英勇奖章的提名名单。

虽然父亲的成就让巴兹肩负重任，但他或许已走在正确的路上。他是麦金利警察学院的优秀毕业生，在尽责、毅力与忠于职守方面获得高评价，担任副手期间也表现出色。被问及承继父亲的功绩有何感想，巴兹表示：「只要有机会，我就会再添上一笔。」

source: Buzzkill: Sheriff Shoots Off Own Toe
target: 巴兹扫兴了：警长开枪打掉自己的脚趾

source:
Sheriff Rodney “Buzz” Snow, son of famed lawman Aldous T. Snow, shot himself in the foot last evening in his home. Doctors at Waldon Emergency Hospital report that the injury is not serious and should not drastically affect motor function, though the Sheriff will be missing a digit on his left foot. “The worst of recovery will be for the ego,” Dr. Maltzinkis said.  

Police records officially describe the incident as an accident. Tess Snow, Sheriff Snow’s wife, confirms that her husband was "sittin' around doin' fancy holster tricks” on the porch. “I just think y’all should know the truth that it was bum luck,” she added.

Indeed, Sheriff Snow has not had the best relationship with lady luck. Four years ago, he gained viral fame on YouTube when a film was posted of him snoozing in his squad car and being startled in comical fashion. For a brief time, Sheriff Snow became the face of a “munchies” internet meme shared widely by marijuana enthusiasts. 

We cannot help but roll our eyes when we compare the merits of our Sheriff’s fame to his father’s, who was known for stopping a local bank robbery and arresting a notorious smuggler in a shootout – a feat that shortlisted him for the Presidential Medal of Valor.

Sheriff Snow issued a brief statement that he will be taking the rest of the week to recover and will be on duty this coming Monday.
target:
知名执法人员阿尔道斯・T・史诺之子、罗德尼「巴兹」史诺警长，昨晚在家中开枪击中自己的脚。沃尔登急救医院的医师表示，伤势并不严重，应不至于大幅影响行动能力，不过警长的左脚将少一根脚趾。马尔钦基斯医师说：「复原过程中，受伤最重的会是自尊。」

警方正式纪录将本案列为意外。警长的妻子泰丝・史诺证实，丈夫当时「坐在门廊上，耍些花俏的拔枪把戏」。她补充：「我只是觉得，大伙该知道真相，就是运气不好。」

的确，史诺警长与幸运女神向来不太投缘。四年前，一段他在巡逻车里打瞌睡、被滑稽地吓醒的影片上传 YouTube，让他在网路爆红。一时之间，史诺警长成了大麻爱好者广泛分享的「嘴馋」迷因主角。

把警长成名的原因，与他父亲的事迹相比，我们实在忍不住翻白眼。老史诺曾制止本地银行抢案，并在枪战中逮捕恶名昭彰的走私犯——这项功绩让他获提名总统英勇奖章。

史诺警长发表简短声明，表示本周剩余时间将休养，并于下周一恢复执勤。

source:
Deputy Fazekas was first on scene. Cordoned the area. 

I called medical examiner and arrived at 6:29. Pushed hard for immediate investigation so we can remove body before school buses start running. 

Medical investigation begins at 7:05 a.m. but is interrupted. 

Romina Zappa ran up to deceased and wailed and cried. Tried to grab deceased. Had to restrain her so she wouldn’t disturb body and examination. She made work hard, called the body “pathfinder” and told us he used to live in the burned-down farmhouse near town. 

Examiner took photos. Hair, fingerprint, and saliva samples gathered. Reporter showed up. 

We bag the body at 7:32 a.m.
target:
法泽卡斯副警长率先抵达现场，封锁区域。

我联络法医，于 6:29 抵达。催促立即勘验，以便在校车开始行驶前移走遗体。

法医勘验于上午 7:05 开始，但遭到打断。

萝蜜娜・扎帕跑向死者，哭喊哀号。试图抓住死者。必须制止她，以免干扰遗体与勘验。她让工作难以进行，称遗体为「寻路者」，并告诉我们，他以前住在镇外那栋烧毁的农舍。

法医拍照。采集毛发、指纹与唾液样本。记者到场。

上午 7:32，将遗体装袋。

source:
Sharon Hwuang was jogging at dawn and reported a 55-K… body hanging from Grand Rosa. 

Body identified as white male, about 6’2”, gray hair, thin, older, rough tattoo of eye on forehead. 

No sign of life, no foul play apparent. Clothes/body suggest no struggle. Visible bruising around neck. Fold-up beach chair knocked over by feet. 

All signs point to suicide by short drop hanging.
target:

死者为白人男性，约六呎二吋高，灰发，消瘦，年纪较长，额头有粗糙的眼睛刺青。

source:
Romina’s details helped us track down property records… body is Isaiah Kosztka, was resident decades ago and left town. Did in fact rent a farmhouse with some acres that had a major field fire. Abandoned since. 

Had previous out-of-state arrests for drug possession. Served 5 years for dealing acid.  

Selfish bastard hanging himself in the middle of town. Good riddance.
target:
